purpose: Anonymized estate-adjacent illustrations excluded from the N=11 catalog. Exercises outside-taxonomy routing on operational-adjacent material without changing the byte-frozen Table IX rows. Not empirical validation evidence.

vignettes.narrative: Users cannot start federated login when upstream DNS for the IdP hostname fails intermittently; no authorize or ACS exchange is observed; edge and IdP processes report healthy on direct reachability tests.
vignettes.rationale: Name-resolution failure precedes any Table IV authentication-path mechanism; forcing directory_federation or protocol_gateway would invent a label.

negative_evidence.directory_federation: No LDAP bind or WAN directory timeout on the authentication path — failure occurs before any federation exchange.
negative_evidence.protocol_gateway: No SAML/OIDC payload reached a gateway — resolution failed upstream.
negative_evidence.edge_side_effect: No edge release or callback step was attempted.

vignettes.why_excluded_from_n11: Layer 1 was limited to assignable illustrations with a Table IV primary home; R1 demonstrates mandatory outside-taxonomy routing on estate-adjacent operations material instead.
